notes:
{開|ひら}く has two main meanings: (1) to open something physical, and (2) to hold/organize an event.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes を particle

DON'T CONFUSE (all use {開|ひら}):
- {開|ひら}く: to open (formal), to hold events
- ⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧: to open by itself (intransitive)
- ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open something (transitive, everyday)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|ひら}く: to open a book
- ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|ひら}く: to hold a meeting
- ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|ひら}く: to throw a party
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|ひら}く: to open a shop/business
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開|ひら}く: to open one's eyes (literary)

REGISTER:
{開|ひら}く sounds more formal/literary than ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ for physical opening. For events, {開|ひら}く is the standard choice.
